cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream, Position

for label, text in [
    ("LF", "X=1\nY=2\nZ=3\n"),
    ("CRLF", "X=1\r\nY=2\r\nZ=3\r\n"),
    ("mixed", "X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n"),
    ("lone CR", "X=1\rY=2\rZ=3\r"),
    ("error CRLF", "BAD LINE\r\nX=1\n"),
]:
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    print(label, [(r.key, r.original.line, r.error) for r in rows])

p = Position.start()
p.advance("a\r\nb")
print("advance one CRLF chunk -> line:", p.line)
p2 = Position.start(); p2.advance("a\r"); p2.advance("\nb")
print("split CRLF across two advances -> line:", p2.line)
EOF

cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream, Position, _newline

cases = {
    "LF": "X=1\nY=2\nZ=3\n",
    "CRLF": "X=1\r\nY=2\r\nZ=3\r\n",
    "mixed": "X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n",
    "no trailing": "X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3",
    "CR only": "X=1\rY=2\rZ=3\r",
}
for name, text in cases.items():
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    print(f"{name:12} lines={[r.original.line for r in rows]}  newline_matches={len(_newline.findall(text))}")

# probe Position.advance directly
p = Position.start()
print("start:", p.chars, p.line)
p.advance("X=1\r\n")
print("after CRLF chunk:", p.chars, p.line)
p.advance("Y=2\n")
print("after LF chunk:", p.chars, p.line)
PY

cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import io
from dotenv import parser

# Trace every advance() call and the value passed during one parse.
orig = parser.Position.advance
def traced(self, string):
    before = (self.chars, self.line)
    orig(self, string)
    print(f"advance({string!r:35}) {before} -> {(self.chars, self.line)}")
parser.Position.advance = traced
print("--- mixed input trace ---")
rows = list(parser.parse_stream(io.StringIO("X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n")))
print("results:", [r.original.line for r in rows])
PY
